gecit.lead: {ad} tops out at {rakim_tam} in {bolge}. {siralama} Below: the road surface, when it is usually closed, the passes around it and a loop you can ride over it.
gecit.siralama: It is the {sira} highest of the {n} passes in {bolge} on the Motoseyir map.
gecit.siralama_tek: It is the only pass in {bolge} on the Motoseyir map.
gecit.kis_var: Usually closed to motor vehicles from {ay1} to {ay2}, going by the seasonal closure recorded for the road. Dates move with the snow every year, so check the road authority’s current notice before you go.
gecit.kis_yok: No seasonal closure is recorded for this road in our data. High roads can still close after snow, so check before you go.
gecit.rakim_not: Elevation is the figure on the pass’s OpenStreetMap entry or its source page; the point is the summit on the road itself.
gecit.tur_p: The web route planner opens with {ad} as the start point. Choose a direction, how long you want to ride and how twisty the roads should be, and it draws up to three round trips that come back to the pass. Send the one you like to your phone with a QR code and ride it in Motoseyir.
gecit.uyg_p1: {ad} is on Motoseyir’s pass map with its altitude and exact location, along with 1,600+ passes in 36 countries. Add it to your tour and go.
gecit.uyg_p2: If your route crosses a pass that may be closed this month, the app tells you before you set off, and Generate a tour skips closed passes. Passes you ride over are ticked off from your ride log automatically.
gecit.veri_not: Pass data: Motoseyir’s pass list, compiled from OpenStreetMap (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL) and the source page linked above.
